_metadata.description: PharmaGuard drug rules — maps drug to primary gene and phenotype risk categories

Ineffective.dosing_guidance: Avoid codeine — patient cannot convert to morphine
Ineffective.monitoring: Monitor for pain relief with alternative agent
Ineffective.cpic_guideline: CPIC Guideline for CYP2D6 and Codeine Therapy (2019)

Adjust Dosage.action: Use with caution at reduced dose or consider alternative
Adjust Dosage.dosing_guidance: Reduced codeine metabolism expected; consider 25-50% dose reduction or alternative
Adjust Dosage.monitoring: Monitor closely for lack of efficacy
Adjust Dosage.cpic_guideline: CPIC Guideline for CYP2D6 and Codeine Therapy (2019)

Safe.cpic_guideline: CPIC Guideline for CYP2D6 and Codeine Therapy (2019)

Toxic.dosing_guidance: Do NOT use codeine — ultrarapid conversion to morphine causes respiratory depression
Toxic.monitoring: If inadvertently given, monitor for respiratory depression
Toxic.cpic_guideline: CPIC Guideline for CYP2D6 and Codeine Therapy (2019)

Adjust Dosage.dosing_guidance: Reduce initial warfarin dose by 25-50% based on CYP2C9 status
Adjust Dosage.monitoring: Frequent INR monitoring, especially during initiation
Adjust Dosage.cpic_guideline: CPIC Guideline for Warfarin and CYP2C9/VKORC1 (2017)

Safe.dosing_guidance: Standard dosing with routine INR monitoring
Safe.cpic_guideline: CPIC Guideline for Warfarin and CYP2C9/VKORC1 (2017)

Ineffective.dosing_guidance: Avoid clopidogrel — patient cannot activate the prodrug
Ineffective.monitoring: Monitor for cardiovascular events on alternative therapy
Ineffective.cpic_guideline: CPIC Guideline for CYP2C19 and Clopidogrel Therapy (2022)

Adjust Dosage.dosing_guidance: Reduced activation expected; consider prasugrel/ticagrelor or increased clopidogrel dose
Adjust Dosage.monitoring: Monitor for cardiovascular events and platelet function
Adjust Dosage.cpic_guideline: CPIC Guideline for CYP2C19 and Clopidogrel Therapy (2022)

Safe.cpic_guideline: CPIC Guideline for CYP2C19 and Clopidogrel Therapy (2022)

Toxic.action: Use alternative statin or lower dose
Toxic.dosing_guidance: Avoid simvastatin >20mg — high risk of myopathy/rhabdomyolysis
Toxic.monitoring: Monitor CK levels; report muscle pain/weakness immediately
Toxic.cpic_guideline: CPIC Guideline for SLCO1B1 and Simvastatin (2014)

Adjust Dosage.dosing_guidance: Limit simvastatin to ≤20mg daily or switch to pravastatin/rosuvastatin
Adjust Dosage.monitoring: Monitor for muscle symptoms and CK levels
Adjust Dosage.cpic_guideline: CPIC Guideline for SLCO1B1 and Simvastatin (2014)

Safe.cpic_guideline: CPIC Guideline for SLCO1B1 and Simvastatin (2014)

Toxic.dosing_guidance: Reduce dose by 90% or avoid azathioprine — severe myelosuppression risk
Toxic.monitoring: Frequent CBC with differential; monitor for myelosuppression
Toxic.cpic_guideline: CPIC Guideline for TPMT/NUDT15 and Thiopurines (2018)

Adjust Dosage.dosing_guidance: Start at 30-70% of standard dose; titrate based on tolerance
Adjust Dosage.monitoring: CBC weekly for first month, then biweekly
Adjust Dosage.cpic_guideline: CPIC Guideline for TPMT/NUDT15 and Thiopurines (2018)

Safe.cpic_guideline: CPIC Guideline for TPMT/NUDT15 and Thiopurines (2018)

Toxic.dosing_guidance: Avoid 5-FU — high risk of fatal toxicity due to DPD deficiency
Toxic.monitoring: If used, monitor for severe mucositis, myelosuppression, neurotoxicity
Toxic.cpic_guideline: CPIC Guideline for DPYD and Fluoropyrimidines (2017)

Adjust Dosage.dosing_guidance: Start at 25-50% of standard dose; titrate based on tolerance
Adjust Dosage.cpic_guideline: CPIC Guideline for DPYD and Fluoropyrimidines (2017)

Safe.cpic_guideline: CPIC Guideline for DPYD and Fluoropyrimidines (2017)
